meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the local Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Bank-wise figures are the banks' own returns as the RBI publishes them and are not revised once printed; the Outlook's latest March is provisional and is replaced by the next edition's figure. Mergers are disclosed on the acquirer, never joined.
meta.coverage: How many urban co-operative banks there are, scheduled and non-scheduled, every March to 2026
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 812, the Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks' Outlook (statistical table), read from the local Data Bank mirror. The source's date column is empty (1 January 1970); its financial year is used. Four sub-groups (display orders 4 to 7) carry no label in either copy of the table and are left out.
